Freeze time and await the queue instead:

```python
import pytest
from freezegun import freeze_time

@freeze_time('2026-01-01')
def test_ingest_batches(queue):
    job = IngestJob(queue, batch_size=100)
    job.run_once()
    assert queue.drained()
```

| Cause | Fix |
|---|---|
| real `time.sleep` | `freeze_time` |
| shared queue between tests | function-scoped fixture |
